title: Representative normalization of the finite realization tensor comparison
statement: Use the prime $\ell$, extension $E$, positive level $m+1$, scheme $X$, realization $F_X$, and local total tensor generators of [def-pod-pairing-tensor-generators]. Write $R_X$ for the derived realization equivalence. A realization chain comparison is a chain isomorphism $F_X\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(F_XP\otimes F_XQ)$. It is normalized when it sends each realized homogeneous local pure tensor generator to the corresponding tensor of realized sections, in every degree and on every site object. A realization derived tensor comparison is a natural isomorphism from the fixed-scalar derived tensor followed by $R_X$ to $(R_X\times R_X)$ followed by the intrinsic derived tensor of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. It is normalized when, for every pair $P,Q$ whose realizations are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], there is a normalized chain comparison and its image under localization gives that component: the square uses the native localization tensor map, both exact-realization localization isomorphisms, and the recorded intrinsic K-flat tensor-model isomorphism. Thus the square specifies the whole component, not only the existence of isomorphic objects.
